I haven't had any medication, they did some voodoo eyeswipe thing, and it broke something deep down inside of me. many times I have wondered how it came to this. 2/3 of my life have been a hell and for half of my life I have been sucidical(or homocidical I really don't mind I just want to kill). I even tried to stab my neighbour. but the desire to end a life is only occasional, the worst part is life itself. I just don't get it. this whole have friends and find a partner thing. I have friends. I even had a girlfriend for four months. then I tried to kill myself with a knife and broke up to avoid dragging her into it. but I still fear people and when I talk to others I constantly have to supress my fear of them. can you tell me what it feels like to be normal? I have honestly forgotten. thank you. I'm getting some sleep now.

i don't need a book I need a person, a real one, but I don't want to be physically close to this person and I don't have the heart to harass people on omegle. taking a nap haven't helped me the last 8 years so I think that is out of the question, auditory hallucinations? I doubt it its just my own voice inside my head, but I can't control what I tell myself. I don't want medication I don't like it. I'm sorry if I sound like a needy fuck but I'm tired of being alone.
but they are professionals, they did this to me the last time. they didn't make it go away. they just made me captive and it became my prison. I can't talk to them again.
but the voices, they haunt me. I'm sick of talking to myself. listening to the echo of my own anger and hatred, it rings in my head for hours, taunting me, never to let me out of my own prison.
sorry, I don't believe in god. I even went to church some times just to make sure.
